|
| auth           | email                                 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.email()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.email', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'email')
  )::text
$function$

| extensions     | grant_pg_cron_access                  | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_cron_access()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
    JOIN pg_extension AS ext
    ON ev.objid = ext.oid
    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_cron'
  )
  THEN
    grant usage on schema cron to postgres with grant option;

    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on tables to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on functions to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on sequences to postgres with grant option;

    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on sequences to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on tables to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on functions to postgres with grant option;

    grant all privileges on all tables in schema cron to postgres with grant option;
    revoke all on table cron.job from postgres;
    grant select on table cron.job to postgres with grant option;
  END IF;
END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| extensions     | grant_pg_graphql_access               | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    func_is_graphql_resolve bool;
BEGIN
    func_is_graphql_resolve = (
        SELECT n.proname = 'resolve'
        FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
        LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS n
        ON ev.objid = n.oid
    );

    IF func_is_graphql_resolve
    THEN
        -- Update public wrapper to pass all arguments through to the pg_graphql resolve func
        DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS graphql_public.graphql;
        create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(
            "operationName" text default null,
            query text default null,
            variables jsonb default null,
            extensions jsonb default null
        )
            returns jsonb
            language sql
        as $$
            select graphql.resolve(
                query := query,
                variables := coalesce(variables, '{}'),
                "operationName" := "operationName",
                extensions := extensions
            );
        $$;

        -- This hook executes when `graphql.resolve` is created. That is not necessarily the last
        -- function in the extension so we need to grant permissions on existing entities AND
        -- update default permissions to any others that are created after `graphql.resolve`
        grant usage on schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        grant select on all tables in schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        grant execute on all functions in schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        grant all on all sequences in schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        alter default privileges in schema graphql grant all on tables to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        alter default privileges in schema graphql grant all on functions to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        alter default privileges in schema graphql grant all on sequences to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;

        -- Allow postgres role to allow granting usage on graphql and graphql_public schemas to custom roles
        grant usage on schema graphql_public to postgres with grant option;
        grant usage on schema graphql to postgres with grant option;
    END IF;

END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| extensions     | grant_pg_net_access                   | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_net_access()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
    JOIN pg_extension AS ext
    ON ev.objid = ext.oid
    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_net'
  )
  THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pg_roles
      WHERE rolname = 'supabase_functions_admin'
    )
    THEN
      CREATE USER supabase_functions_admin NOINHERIT CREATEROLE LOGIN NOREPLICATION;
    END IF;

    GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA net TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;

    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT FROM pg_extension
      WHERE extname = 'pg_net'
      -- all versions in use on existing projects as of 2025-02-20
      -- version 0.12.0 onwards don't need these applied
      AND extversion IN ('0.2', '0.6', '0.7', '0.7.1', '0.8', '0.10.0', '0.11.0')
    ) THEN
      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;
      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;

      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;
      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;

      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;
      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;

      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| extensions     | pgrst_ddl_watch                       | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
  LOOP
    IF cmd.command_tag IN (
      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'
    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'
    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'
    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'
    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'
    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'
    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'
    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'
    , 'CREATE RULE'
    , 'COMMENT'
    )
    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp
    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| extensions     | pgrst_drop_watch                      | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  obj record;
BEGIN
  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()
  LOOP
    IF obj.object_type IN (
      'schema'
    , 'table'
    , 'foreign table'
    , 'view'
    , 'materialized view'
    , 'function'
    , 'trigger'
    , 'type'
    , 'rule'
    )
    AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| extensions     | set_graphql_placeholder               | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.set_graphql_placeholder()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
    DECLARE
    graphql_is_dropped bool;
    BEGIN
    graphql_is_dropped = (
        SELECT ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'
        FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() AS ev
        WHERE ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'
    );

    IF graphql_is_dropped
    THEN
        create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(
            "operationName" text default null,
            query text default null,
            variables jsonb default null,
            extensions jsonb default null
        )
            returns jsonb
            language plpgsql
        as $$
            DECLARE
                server_version float;
            BEGIN
                server_version = (SELECT (SPLIT_PART((select version()), ' ', 2))::float);

                IF server_version >= 14 THEN
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql extension is not enabled.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                ELSE
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql is only available on projects running Postgres 14 onwards.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                END IF;
            END;
        $$;
    END IF;

    END;
$function$

| graphql        | comment_directive                     | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION graphql.comment_directive(comment_ text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    /*
    comment on column public.account.name is '@graphql.name: myField'
    */
    select
        coalesce(
            (
                regexp_match(
                    comment_,
                    '@graphql\((.+)\)'
                )
            )[1]::jsonb,
            jsonb_build_object()
        )
$function$

| graphql        | resolve                               | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION graphql.resolve(query text, variables jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, "operationName" text DEFAULT NULL::text, extensions jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    res jsonb;
    message_text text;
begin
  begin
    select graphql._internal_resolve("query" := "query",
                                     "variables" := "variables",
                                     "operationName" := "operationName",
                                     "extensions" := "extensions") into res;
    return res;
  exception
    when others then
    get stacked diagnostics message_text = message_text;
    return
    jsonb_build_object('data', null,
                       'errors', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('message', message_text)));
  end;
end;
$function$

               |
| net            | _await_response                       | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION net._await_response(request_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    rec net._http_response;
begin
    while rec is null loop
        select *
        into rec
        from net._http_response
        where id = request_id;

        if rec is null then
            -- Wait 50 ms before checking again
            perform pg_sleep(0.05);
        end if;
    end loop;

    return true;
end;

                                                                                                                 |
| net            | _http_collect_response                | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION net._http_collect_response(request_id bigint, async boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS net.http_response_result
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    rec net._http_response;
    req_exists boolean;
begin

    if not async then
        perform net._await_response(request_id);
    end if;

    select *
    into rec
    from net._http_response
    where id = request_id;

    if rec is null or rec.error_msg is not null then
        -- The request is either still processing or the request_id provided does not exist

        -- TODO: request in progress is indistinguishable from request that doesn't exist

        -- No request matching request_id found
        return (
            'ERROR',
            coalesce(rec.error_msg, 'request matching request_id not found'),
            null
        )::net.http_response_result;

    end if;

    -- Return a valid, populated http_response_result
    return (
        'SUCCESS',
        'ok',
        (
            rec.status_code,
            rec.headers,
            rec.content
        )::net.http_response
    )::net.http_response_result;
end;

| net            | check_worker_is_up                    | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION net.check_worker_is_up()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  if not exists (select pid from pg_stat_activity where backend_type ilike '%pg_net%') then
    raise exception using
      message = 'the pg_net background worker is not up'
    , detail  = 'the pg_net background worker is down due to an internal error and cannot process requests'
    , hint    = 'make sure that you didn''t modify any of pg_net internal tables';
  end if;
end

                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| net            | http_delete                           | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION net.http_delete(url text, params jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, headers jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer DEFAULT 5000, body jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    request_id bigint;
    params_array text[];
begin
    select coalesce(array_agg(net._urlencode_string(key) || '=' || net._urlencode_string(value)), '{}')
    into params_array
    from jsonb_each_text(params);

    -- Add to the request queue
    insert into net.http_request_queue(method, url, headers, body, timeout_milliseconds)
    values (
        'DELETE',
        net._encode_url_with_params_array(url, params_array),
        headers,
        convert_to(body::text, 'UTF8'),
        timeout_milliseconds
    )
    returning id
    into request_id;

    perform net.wake();

    return request_id;
end

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| net            | http_post                             | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, params jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, headers jsonb DEFAULT '{"Content-Type": "application/json"}'::jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer DEFAULT 5000)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    request_id bigint;
    params_array text[];
    content_type text;
begin

    -- Exctract the content_type from headers
    select
        header_value into content_type
    from
        jsonb_each_text(coalesce(headers, '{}'::jsonb)) r(header_name, header_value)
    where
        lower(header_name) = 'content-type'
    limit
        1;

    -- If the user provided new headers and omitted the content type
    -- add it back in automatically
    if content_type is null then
        select headers || '{"Content-Type": "application/json"}'::jsonb into headers;
    end if;

    -- Confirm that the content-type is set as "application/json"
    if content_type <> 'application/json' then
        raise exception 'Content-Type header must be "application/json"';
    end if;

    select
        coalesce(array_agg(net._urlencode_string(key) || '=' || net._urlencode_string(value)), '{}')
    into
        params_array
    from
        jsonb_each_text(params);

    -- Add to the request queue
    insert into net.http_request_queue(method, url, headers, body, timeout_milliseconds)
    values (
        'POST',
        net._encode_url_with_params_array(url, params_array),
        headers,
        convert_to(body::text, 'UTF8'),
        timeout_milliseconds
    )
    returning id
    into request_id;

    perform net.wake();

    return request_id;
end
$function$

| pgbouncer      | get_auth                              | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pgbouncer.get_auth(p_usename text)
 RETURNS TABLE(username text, password text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  BEGIN
      RAISE DEBUG 'PgBouncer auth request: %', p_usename;

      RETURN QUERY
      SELECT
          rolname::text,
          CASE WHEN rolvaliduntil < now()
              THEN null
              ELSE rolpassword::text
          END
      FROM pg_authid
      WHERE rolname=$1 and rolcanlogin;
  END;
  $function$

| public         | assign_master_recruiter               | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_master_recruiter()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE master_role_id UUID;
BEGIN
  IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profiles WHERE user_type = 'recruiter') = 1 THEN
    SELECT id INTO master_role_id FROM roles WHERE name = 'Master Recruiter';
    INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id, assigned_by) VALUES (NEW.id, master_role_id, NEW.id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

| public         | check_permission                      | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_permission(user_uuid uuid, permission_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM permissions p
    JOIN role_permissions rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id
    JOIN user_roles ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id
    WHERE ur.user_id = user_uuid AND p.name = permission_name
  );
END;
$function$

 RETURNS void

 SECURITY DEFINER

  WHERE expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months';

| public         | enforce_coordinator_restrictions      | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_coordinator_restrictions()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- If user has update_status_only permission (coordinator)
  IF check_permission(auth.uid(), 'update_status_only') AND 
     NOT check_permission(auth.uid(), 'manage_applications') THEN
    
    -- Allow ONLY status changes, block everything else
    IF OLD.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.user_id OR
       OLD.applied_rank IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.applied_rank OR
       OLD.full_name IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.full_name OR
       OLD.email IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.email OR
       OLD.phone IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.phone OR
       OLD.nationality IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.nationality OR
       OLD.current_rank IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_rank OR
       OLD.years_experience IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.years_experience OR
       OLD.vessel_type IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.vessel_type OR
       OLD.coc IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.coc OR
       OLD.coc_country IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.coc_country THEN
      
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Coordinators can only update status field';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

| public         | extract_expiries_for_application      | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.extract_expiries_for_application(app_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(success boolean, message text, documents_extracted integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  result JSONB;
BEGIN
  -- Call edge function
  SELECT content::jsonb INTO result
  FROM net.http_post(
    url := current_setting('app.supabase_url') || '/functions/v1/extract-document-expiries',
    headers := jsonb_build_object(
      'Content-Type', 'application/json',
      'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || current_setting('app.supabase_service_role_key')
    ),
    body := jsonb_build_object(
      'applicationId', app_id::text
    )
  );
  
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    TRUE as success,
    'Extraction triggered' as message,
    COALESCE((result->>'documentsExtracted')::integer, 0) as documents_extracted;
    
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    FALSE as success,
    SQLERRM as message,
    0 as documents_extracted;
END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| public         | extract_expiries_for_application_sql  | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.extract_expiries_for_application_sql(app_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(success boolean, message text, documents_extracted integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  app_data JSONB;
  user_id_val UUID;
  doc_count INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Get application data
  SELECT 
    a.user_id,
    ad.data
  INTO user_id_val, app_data
  FROM applications a
  LEFT JOIN application_data ad ON a.id = ad.application_id
  WHERE a.id = app_id;

  IF user_id_val IS NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT FALSE, 'Application not found', 0;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF app_data IS NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT FALSE, 'No application data found', 0;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Delete existing expiry records for this application
  DELETE FROM document_expiries WHERE application_id = app_id;

  -- Section 3: Passport
  IF app_data->'section3'->>'dateOfExpiry' IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO document_expiries (
      application_id, user_id, document_type, document_name, section_number,
      expiry_date, issuing_authority, certificate_number, place_of_issue
    ) VALUES (
      app_id, user_id_val, 'passport', 'Passport', 3,
      (app_data->'section3'->>'dateOfExpiry')::DATE,
      app_data->'section3'->>'issuingAuthority',
      app_data->'section3'->>'passportNumber',
      app_data->'section3'->>'placeOfIssue'
    );
    doc_count := doc_count + 1;
  END IF;

  -- Section 4: Seaman's Book
  IF app_data->'section4'->>'dateOfExpiry' IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO document_expiries (
      application_id, user_id, document_type, document_name, section_number,
      expiry_date, issuing_authority, certificate_number, place_of_issue
    ) VALUES (
      app_id, user_id_val, 'seaman_book', 'Seaman''s Book (CDC)', 4,
      (app_data->'section4'->>'dateOfExpiry')::DATE,
      app_data->'section4'->>'issuingAuthority',
      app_data->'section4'->>'cdcNumber',
      app_data->'section4'->>'placeOfIssue'
    );
    doc_count := doc_count + 1;
  END IF;

  -- Section 5: Visas (array)
  IF app_data->'section5'->'visas' IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO document_expiries (
      application_id, user_id, document_type, document_name, section_number,
      expiry_date, issuing_authority, certificate_number, place_of_issue
    )
    SELECT 
      app_id, user_id_val, 'visa',
      COALESCE(visa->>'country', 'Unknown') || ' Visa',
      5,
      (visa->>'dateOfExpiry')::DATE,
      visa->>'issuingAuthority',
      visa->>'visaNumber',
      visa->>'placeOfIssue'
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(app_data->'section5'->'visas') AS visa
    WHERE visa->>'dateOfExpiry' IS NOT NULL;
    
    GET DIAGNOSTICS doc_count = ROW_COUNT;
    doc_count := doc_count + doc_count;
  END IF;

  -- Section 8: Certificates of Competency (array)
  IF app_data->'section8'->'certificates' IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO document_expiries (
      application_id, user_id, document_type, document_name, section_number,
      expiry_date, issuing_authority, certificate_number, place_of_issue
    )
    SELECT 
      app_id, user_id_val, 'coc',
      COALESCE(cert->>'certificateType', 'CoC') || ' - ' || COALESCE(cert->>'rank', 'Unknown'),
      8,
      (cert->>'dateOfExpiry')::DATE,
      cert->>'issuingAuthority',
      cert->>'certificateNumber',
      cert->>'placeOfIssue'
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(app_data->'section8'->'certificates') AS cert
    WHERE cert->>'dateOfExpiry' IS NOT NULL;
    
    GET DIAGNOSTICS doc_count = ROW_COUNT;
    doc_count := doc_count + doc_count;
  END IF;

  -- Section 9: GMDSS (array)
  IF app_data->'section9'->'gmdss' IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO document_expiries (
      application_id, user_id, document_type, document_name, section_number,
      expiry_date, issuing_authority, certificate_number, place_of_issue
    )
    SELECT 
      app_id, user_id_val, 'gmdss',
      'GMDSS - ' || COALESCE(cert->>'certificateType', 'Certificate'),
      9,
      (cert->>'dateOfExpiry')::DATE,
      cert->>'issuingAuthority',
      cert->>'certificateNumber',
      cert->>'placeOfIssue'
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(app_data->'section9'->'gmdss') AS cert
    WHERE cert->>'dateOfExpiry' IS NOT NULL;
    
    GET DIAGNOSTICS doc_count = ROW_COUNT;
    doc_count := doc_count + doc_count;
  END IF;

  -- Section 10: Medical Certificates (array)
  IF app_data->'section10'->'medicals' IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO document_expiries (
      application_id, user_id, document_type, document_name, section_number,
      expiry_date, issuing_authority, certificate_number, place_of_issue
    )
    SELECT 
      app_id, user_id_val, 'medical',
      'Medical Certificate - ' || COALESCE(med->>'certificateType', 'Unknown'),
      10,
      (med->>'dateOfExpiry')::DATE,
      med->>'issuingAuthority',
      med->>'certificateNumber',
      med->>'placeOfIssue'
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(app_data->'section10'->'medicals') AS med
    WHERE med->>'dateOfExpiry' IS NOT NULL;
    
    GET DIAGNOSTICS doc_count = ROW_COUNT;
    doc_count := doc_count + doc_count;
  END IF;

  -- Section 10: Yellow Fever (single, check lifetime validity)
  IF app_data->'section10'->'vaccinations'->'yellowFever' IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF COALESCE((app_data->'section10'->'vaccinations'->'yellowFever'->>'lifetimeValidity')::BOOLEAN, FALSE) = FALSE
       AND app_data->'section10'->'vaccinations'->'yellowFever'->>'dateOfExpiry' IS NOT NULL THEN
      INSERT INTO document_expiries (
        application_id, user_id, document_type, document_name, section_number,
        expiry_date, issuing_authority, certificate_number, place_of_issue
      ) VALUES (
        app_id, user_id_val, 'yellow_fever', 'Yellow Fever Vaccination', 10,
        (app_data->'section10'->'vaccinations'->'yellowFever'->>'dateOfExpiry')::DATE,
        app_data->'section10'->'vaccinations'->'yellowFever'->>'issuingAuthority',
        app_data->'section10'->'vaccinations'->'yellowFever'->>'certificateNumber',
        app_data->'section10'->'vaccinations'->'yellowFever'->>'placeOfIssue'
      );
      doc_count := doc_count + 1;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Section 14: Courses (array)
  IF app_data->'section14'->'courses' IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO document_expiries (
      application_id, user_id, document_type, document_name, section_number,
      expiry_date, issuing_authority, certificate_number, place_of_issue
    )
    SELECT 
      app_id, user_id_val, 'course',
      'Course - ' || COALESCE(course->>'courseName', 'Unknown'),
      14,
      (course->>'dateOfExpiry')::DATE,
      course->>'issuingAuthority',
      course->>'certificateNumber',
      course->>'placeOfIssue'
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(app_data->'section14'->'courses') AS course
    WHERE course->>'dateOfExpiry' IS NOT NULL;
    
    GET DIAGNOSTICS doc_count = ROW_COUNT;
    doc_count := doc_count + doc_count;
  END IF;

  -- Section 15: Endorsements (array)
  IF app_data->'section15'->'endorsements' IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO document_expiries (
      application_id, user_id, document_type, document_name, section_number,
      expiry_date, issuing_authority, certificate_number, place_of_issue
    )
    SELECT 
      app_id, user_id_val, 'endorsement',
      COALESCE(endors->>'flagState', 'Unknown') || ' Endorsement - ' || COALESCE(endors->>'endorsementType', ''),
      15,
      (endors->>'dateOfExpiry')::DATE,
      endors->>'flagState',
      endors->>'endorsementNumber',
      endors->>'placeOfIssue'
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(app_data->'section15'->'endorsements') AS endors
    WHERE endors->>'dateOfExpiry' IS NOT NULL;
    
    GET DIAGNOSTICS doc_count = ROW_COUNT;
    doc_count := doc_count + doc_count;
  END IF;

  -- Get actual count
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO doc_count FROM document_expiries WHERE application_id = app_id;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT TRUE, 'Extraction successful', doc_count;
  
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT FALSE, SQLERRM, 0;
END;
$function$
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| public         | get_documents_needing_warnings        | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_documents_needing_warnings()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, application_id uuid, user_id uuid, document_type text, document_name text, expiry_date date, days_until_expiry integer, is_expired boolean, applicant_name text, applicant_email text, reference_number text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    de.id,
    de.application_id,
    de.user_id,
    de.document_type,
    de.document_name,
    de.expiry_date,
    days_until_expiry(de.expiry_date) as days_until_expiry,
    is_document_expired(de.expiry_date) as is_expired,
    -- Build full name from application data (firstName + surname)
    COALESCE(
      TRIM(
        CONCAT(
          ad.data->'section2'->>'firstName', 
          ' ', 
          ad.data->'section2'->>'surname'
        )
      ),
      p.full_name  -- Fallback to profile name if application data missing
    ) as applicant_name,
    p.email as applicant_email,
    a.reference_number
  FROM document_expiries de
  JOIN applications a ON de.application_id = a.id
  JOIN profiles p ON de.user_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN application_data ad ON ad.application_id = a.id
  WHERE 
    -- Document is expired OR expiring within 90 days
    (is_document_expired(de.expiry_date) OR days_until_expiry(de.expiry_date) <= 90)
    -- And application is not in draft status
    AND a.status != 'draft'
  ORDER BY de.expiry_date ASC;
END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| public         | get_expiring_certificates             | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_expiring_certificates(days_ahead integer DEFAULT 90)
 RETURNS TABLE(certificate_id uuid, user_id uuid, applicant_email text, applicant_name text, certificate_type text, certificate_name text, expiry_date date, days_until_expiry integer, needs_90_day boolean, needs_60_day boolean, needs_30_day boolean, needs_expired boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        c.id as certificate_id,
        c.user_id,
        p.email as applicant_email,
        COALESCE(p.full_name, p.email) as applicant_name,
        c.certificate_type,
        c.certificate_name,
        c.expiry_date,
        (c.expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE)::INTEGER as days_until_expiry,
        (c.expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE <= 90 AND NOT c.notification_90_sent) as needs_90_day,
        (c.expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE <= 60 AND NOT c.notification_60_sent) as needs_60_day,
        (c.expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE <= 30 AND NOT c.notification_30_sent) as needs_30_day,
        (c.expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE AND NOT c.notification_expired_sent) as needs_expired
    FROM certificate_expiry_tracking c
    JOIN profiles p ON p.id = c.user_id
    WHERE c.expiry_date <= CURRENT_DATE + days_ahead
    OR c.expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE
    ORDER BY c.expiry_date ASC;
END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| public         | get_expiring_documents_summary        | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_expiring_documents_summary()
 RETURNS TABLE(urgency_level text, count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    get_urgency_level(de.expiry_date) as urgency_level,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM document_expiries de
  WHERE days_until_expiry(de.expiry_date) <= 90 OR is_document_expired(de.expiry_date)
  GROUP BY get_urgency_level(de.expiry_date)
  ORDER BY 
    CASE get_urgency_level(de.expiry_date)
      WHEN 'expired' THEN 1
      WHEN 'critical' THEN 2
      WHEN 'urgent' THEN 3
      WHEN 'moderate' THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END;
END;
$function$

                                                                  |
| public         | get_team_stats                        | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_team_stats()
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE result JSON;
BEGIN
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'total', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profiles WHERE user_type = 'recruiter'),
    'master', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE r.name = 'Master Recruiter'),
    'recruiter', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE r.name = 'Recruiter')
  ) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| public         | get_upcoming_events                   | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_upcoming_events(recruiter_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, days_ahead integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(event_id uuid, application_id uuid, applicant_name text, event_type text, event_title text, scheduled_date date, scheduled_time time without time zone, duration_minutes integer, status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    se.id,
    se.application_id,
    COALESCE(
      ad.data->'section2'->>'firstName' || ' ' || ad.data->'section2'->>'surname',
      p.full_name
    ) as applicant_name,
    se.event_type,
    se.event_title,
    se.scheduled_date,
    se.scheduled_time,
    se.duration_minutes,
    se.status
  FROM scheduled_events se
  JOIN applications a ON se.application_id = a.id
  LEFT JOIN application_data ad ON a.id = ad.application_id
  LEFT JOIN profiles p ON a.user_id = p.id
  WHERE 
    se.scheduled_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + days_ahead
    AND (recruiter_id IS NULL OR se.scheduled_by = recruiter_id)
    AND se.status IN ('scheduled', 'rescheduled')
  ORDER BY se.scheduled_date ASC, se.scheduled_time ASC;
END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| public         | get_upcoming_events                   | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_upcoming_events(days_ahead integer DEFAULT 7)
 RETURNS TABLE(event_id uuid, application_id uuid, event_type text, scheduled_datetime timestamp with time zone, applicant_email text, applicant_name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        se.id as event_id,
        se.application_id,
        se.event_type,
        (se.scheduled_date + se.scheduled_time)::TIMESTAMPTZ as scheduled_datetime,
        p.email as applicant_email,
        COALESCE(p.full_name, p.email) as applicant_name
    FROM scheduled_events se
    JOIN applications a ON a.id = se.application_id
    JOIN profiles p ON p.id = a.user_id
    WHERE se.scheduled_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + days_ahead
    AND se.status = 'scheduled'
    ORDER BY se.scheduled_date, se.scheduled_time;
END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| public         | get_urgency_level                     | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_urgency_level(expiry_date date)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  days_remaining INTEGER;
BEGIN
  days_remaining := expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE;
  
  IF expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN
    RETURN 'expired';
  ELSIF days_remaining <= 30 THEN
    RETURN 'critical';
  ELSIF days_remaining <= 60 THEN
    RETURN 'urgent';
  ELSIF days_remaining <= 90 THEN
    RETURN 'moderate';
  ELSE
    RETURN 'normal';
  END IF;
END;
$function$

| public         | get_user_permissions                  | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_permissions(user_uuid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(permission_name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT DISTINCT p.name as permission_name
  FROM role_assignments ra
  JOIN role_permissions rp ON ra.role_id = rp.role_id
  JOIN permissions p ON rp.permission_id = p.id
  WHERE ra.user_id = user_uuid;
END;
$function$

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| public         | get_user_role                         | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_role(user_uuid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(role_name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT r.name as role_name
  FROM role_assignments ra
  JOIN roles r ON ra.role_id = r.id
  WHERE ra.user_id = user_uuid
  LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$
